description: Private dashboards; observed associations do not establish causation. UTC storage; America/Chicago reporting. Events deduplicated by insert ID. Inquiries count application receipt, independently of email acceptance. Funnels: denominator distinct starting sessions/browsers, ordered steps, first valid conversion per aggregate, counts + percent of start; 30-minute same-session or explicitly labeled 7-day browser window. Date range defaults to 30 days; adjust insight filters/date comparison and export in PostHog. Replay/heatmaps opened in PostHog Replay/Heatmaps with the same project and date filters. Limits/consent/blocking reduce analytics totals relative to owner inbox.

source.query: SELECT properties.session_id AS session, argMin(properties.page_path,timestamp) AS landing, argMax(properties.page_path,timestamp) AS exit, countIf(event='page_view') AS pages FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY session ORDER BY pages DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT properties.intent AS topic, count() AS zero_result_searches FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event='search' AND properties.count=0 GROUP BY topic

SELECT timestamp, properties.session_id AS session, event, properties.page_path AS page, properties.project_id AS project FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT toDate(timestamp,'America/Chicago') AS day, count() AS responses, sum(properties.tokens) AS tokens, sum(properties.cost_usd) AS estimated_usd, avg(properties.latency_ms) AS mean_latency_ms, avg(properties.count) AS mean_retrieval_count FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event='response_complete' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

insights.name: Direct contact (no research/assistant interaction in session)

source.query: SELECT count() AS direct_contact_sessions FROM (SELECT properties.session_id AS session, countIf(event='inquiry_received') AS inquiries, countIf(event IN ('research_result','project_view','assistant_open')) AS discovery FROM events WHERE properties.environment = 'production' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY session HAVING inquiries>0 AND discovery=0)
